label: September 28 – October 4, 2026
intro: Last chance for the pottery workshop + the Marvel Experience is calling Thor's name this weekend!
weekday_note: Tuesday is English-show day at the Bangkok Planetarium — 10am sharp, arrive early for front-row seats.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.location: The Marvel Experience Thailand, Bang Phli, Samut Prakan (~30–40 min from central BKK by Grab)
activities.price: ~500–800 THB (book on Klook for up to 20% off)
activities.why: Iron Man suits, 4D projections, 20+ Marvel heroes — Thor gets to meet his namesake AND Iron Man in one place. This one is pure magic for a 5-year-old.
activities.tip: Pre-book on Klook to skip queues. Grab from Sukhumvit costs ~200–300 THB. Avoid going after 3pm on weekends — quieter in the morning.

activities.title: Ceramic Workshop for Kids — Last Call at ClassBento
activities.time: 3:00 PM sessions (check ClassBento for current slots)
activities.location: Charm-Learn Studio, Phra Nakhon (Bangkok Old Town)
activities.price: ฿7,000 per person (min 2 guests = ฿14,000 for you + Thor), 1.5 hrs
activities.why: This is the last week these slots are available. Thor gets to make his own pottery — pinch pots, slab work — and decorate them himself.
activities.tip: Slots fill quickly so book via classbento.co.th now. Weekdays are quieter and the teacher has more time for kids.

activities.title: Rollerblading at Roller Dome — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (BTS Phrom Phong)
activities.why: Thor's favourite — a big smooth rink with coaches to help him build confidence. Easy to pop in any time of the day.
activities.tip: Go at opening (11am) for a relaxed start. The rink gets busier mid-afternoon. Easy to combine with Emporium food court for lunch.

activities.title: Bangkok Planetarium English Show
activities.location: Science Center for Education, Sukhumvit (BTS Ekkamai)
activities.price: ~30–50 THB kids / ~50 THB adults for planetarium; free to enter museum
activities.why: 360-degree dome show about stars and space — perfect for a curious kid who loves Iron Man flying through the sky. The science museum buildings around it are a bonus.
activities.tip: Tuesday English show is the best day for expats. Get there by 9:45am to guarantee a seat. Museum opens at 8:30am — explore before the show.

activities.title: Ice Skating at The Rink — Central World
activities.location: The Rink, Floor 2 Zone Forum, CentralWorld (BTS Chit Lom)
activities.why: Any day Thor wants to skate — practice penguins for the little ones, professional coaches available, smooth ice.
activities.tip: Weekdays are cheaper and much less crowded. A weekday morning session is pure joy.
